recommendations.title: Increase Budget for SMS Channel

what_you_should_do.how: Increase the budget incrementally and monitor performance to ensure continued efficiency.
guardrails: Ensure the increase does not exceed the channel's capacity to maintain performance.

expected_impact.explanation: Increasing budget in a high-performing channel should lead to more conversions and new customers.
